europe_now.title: Tanker Ablaze Off Romania Following Drone Attack
europe_now.summary: A drone attack left a tanker ablaze off the coast of Romania, resulting in seven missing crew members. NATO allies are scheduled to meet to discuss the maritime security incident.

europe_now.title: Student Protests and Unrest in Albania
europe_now.summary: Anti-government demonstrations in Albania have continued into their third day, involving clashes between police and protesters. During the student protests, the College of Europe campus was looted and torched.

sources.headline: Police and protesters face off in Albania on third day of anti-govt demonstrations

top_stories.title: European Union Budget and Policy Negotiations
top_stories.summary: Emmanuel Macron warned EU leaders that they must reach an agreement on the bloc's budget by the end of the year. Meanwhile, the European Council summit involved extended debates over carbon pricing and car emissions taxation.

sources.headline: Macron warns EU leaders they need to agree budget by end of year

top_stories.summary: Ukraine has resumed strikes on Russian oil refineries as leverage for potential peace talks. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has also urged continued international unity and financial support.

top_stories.title: EU Trade Policy and China Relations
top_stories.summary: European Union leaders are moving toward a unified stance on tougher trade defense measures regarding China. The European Commission is considering specific safeguards on imported Chinese chemicals and machinery.
